network_enforcement: The checker performs only local hash, JSON, Git-state, authority, and receipt reconciliation. It opens no socket and invokes no network-capable package operation. The separately recorded source replay is snapshot-agnostic warm nonrelease evidence, not part of this decision-only recipe.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact seven-line negative release reconciliation summary

scope_boundary: This bounded worker recipe decides the current fail-closed release verdict by binding structured authority and provisional evidence. It cannot master-accept the validation dependency, refresh the ancestor-bound validation receipt, reconcile the proof route into accepted graph state, supply H0/R0 or complete trust/provenance/SBOM evidence, perform a cold offline build, act as an independent verifier, or grant release acceptance.
